steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "19.7.44.1 | PATCH | Ensure Always install with elevated privileges is set to Disabled"
  when: win19cis_rule_19_7_44_1
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_19.7.44.1
    - patch
    - permissions
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_9
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKU:\{{ item }}\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer
    name: AlwaysInstallElevated
    data: 0
    type: dword
  loop: "{{ discovered_hku_loaded_list }}"
  notify: Change_Requires_Reboot
